title: Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Naeh
body: Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Naeh, 75, principal of Or Torah Talmud Torah, died after collapsing on Shabbos. He was rushed to the hospital in critical condition and pronounced dead Monday morning.

title: ArtScroll Black Friday Deals
body: ArtScroll offers lowest prices of the year on Torah treasures with free shipping in the USA for one week, perfect for upgrading learning or gifting for Chanukah.
